about: The postcommunio of the formulary “Mass of the Easter Vigil” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Pour into us, O Lord, the Spirit of Thy charity, that those whom Thou hast satisfied with the paschal sacraments Thou mayest by Thy loving-kindness make of one heart. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end.
